messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Uppáhalds staðir eru víðsvegar út um allt land í íslenskri náttúru. Grábrók, mikið hlegið af nafninu og fyrsta stopp þegar fjölskyldan lagði af stað í hringferð um landið þar sem hver staður var öðrum fallegri, fossar, vötn og lækir, íslensku jurtirnar okkar, bláber, krækiber og hundasúrur um allt land, ferskt og ískalt vatn og heitt vatn, náttúrulaugar og fallegir baðstaðir út um allt land, ferskt loft, vera með fjölskyldunni í undurfagri náttúru út um allt land, kyrðin, góður matur og ........

message.content: Favorite places are all over the country in Icelandic nature. Grábrók, much laughed at because of the name and the first stop when the family set off on a tour around the country where each place was more beautiful than the last, waterfalls, lakes and streams, our Icelandic plants, blueberries, crowberries and sorrel all over the country, fresh and ice-cold water and hot water, natural pools and beautiful bathing spots all over the country, fresh air, being with the family in wonderfully beautiful nature all over the country, the silence, good food and ........
